messages.subject: effect size from T-SEM
parts:
Hi,

I am considering the use of T-SEM for multi-trait TWAS.  I wonder gene-trait association effect sizes can be obtained?  Here trait is a learned factor-based outcome, I guess.  My question is related to summary statistics based TWAS methods where typically effect sizes are not a part of output, but I think it is possible to calculate effect sizes with Z score and estimated se if needed.  So, I wonder the same procedure is available for T-SEM and if so, where to look at finding related information.

JK

messages.author: ac421cf36d1a4c37
messages.subject: Re: effect size from T-SEM
parts:
Yes, effect sizes are computed in T-SEM as a matter of course. Please see “ Scaling TWAS output for T-SEM” in 
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-022-33724-9
Elliot
